newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP August copper output up 42 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP August copper output up 42 pct.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Tuesday its copper in concentrate production jumped 42 percent to 60,400 tonnes in August from a year earlier.
The jump reflected the acquisition of Magma Copper and the Phase Three expansion of its 57.5 percent owned La Escondida mine in Chile, BHP said in its August production report.

Copper concentrate output from the Ok Tedi mine in Papua New Guinea (PNG) declined last month on August 1995 as a result of continued lower headgrades and recoveries, combined with lower mill throughput.
Shipments of copper in concentrate were lower for August due to poor weather in Papua New Guinea and the timing of shipments.
Production of the San Manuel smelter in the United States of America was affected by a shutdown for maintenance.
